sources.version_or_date: live definition; March 2003 origin confirmed by opened revision history
sources.sections_read: Pattern context, problem, two implementation approaches
sources.confirmed: The pattern recommends repeated deliveries having the same effect through deduplication or idempotent message semantics.
sources.limits: This is a general messaging pattern, so a stable occurrence identity, Kubernetes API conflict handling and recovery after partial success require an explicit controller-specific design.
